name: search_memory
description:
Search the local memory base. Returns top cards ranked by BM25
        relevance boosted with a freshness factor (half-life 120 days).

name: recent
description: Return the newest memory cards from the last `days` days.

name: get_card
description: Return the full content of one memory card by id.

name: project_brief
description: Compact brief of the project that owns `cwd` (resolved by its git root): decisions in force (without superseded ones), recent errors and pitfalls, pinned records and possibly stale cards, with card ids for get_card. Unknown folder returns a short note, not an error.
